statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security lead, risk acceptor, and incident commander
Risk assessment every July, before MSA renewals, and after major change
Risk decision rules; no release risk accepted above Low
Annual self-assessment with outside review every second year
Annual policy review and before MSA renewals
No system access for day helpers; sanctions for any future workforce
Written, time-limited exceptions that never override a contract
Customer data only in approved services
Contract requirements register read before each renewal
Terms check and customer consent before any new service or AI tool
Annual provider review including SOC 2 reports
Customer-approved remote access only; shared logins reported; session log; no saved passwords
IT technician sessions started and watched by the owner
Own accounts; no shared credentials except customer-imposed ones
MFA on every service that offers it; authenticator app preferred
Password manager only; no password lists; device defaults changed
Standard daily laptop account; administrator only for installs
Device lock after 5 minutes (phone 1 minute)
Sealed emergency access envelope with recovery codes and backup locations
Monthly sign-in review and POA&M check
Three-level data classification
No Restricted data in unlisted AI tools or websites
Laptop and program drives encrypted
Email approval and change log for every logic or setpoint change; safety shutdowns never bypassed
Offline program backup after each change and monthly; customer copy; quarterly restore test
W-9 scans deleted after entry; paper locked
Disposal, return, and deletion within 30 days after an MSA ends
Six-year retention of security records
Business use only; no family use
Updates and antivirus on; trusted software sources; quarterly software check
Only labeled program drives on customer equipment, scanned before each use
No customer connection with an alert; never bridge networks
Approved AI tools only; AI never changes setpoints directly
Annual security course and one OT security course
Incident runbook with printed contact sheet
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Customer A notice within 24 hours; same-day notice to other connected customers
Florida notices on time
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Annual walkthrough; lessons learned within 30 days
Written mutual coverage agreement and route sheets
Hurricane steps: confirm shut-in order, update backup
